   "source": [
    "import porespy as ps\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from PIL import Image\n",
    "import os"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 63,
   "id": "72434c82",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Current working directory: /Users/lruepke/HydrothermalFoam_run/Spheres/phi_05/geometry\n",
      "Porosity: 0.558\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 400x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# 1. create a random sphere model using porespy\n",
    "\n",
    "# show working directory\n",
    "print(f\"Current working directory: {os.getcwd()}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "shape           = [1256, 1256]      # size of the image in pixels\n",
    "volume_fraction = 1               # approximately 1-porosity depending on radius and the boundary conditions\n",
    "edges           = 'extended'        # 'extended' means that the spheres can extend beyond the image boundaries\n",
    "clearance       = 10               # minimum distance between spheres in pixels\n",
    "r               = 25                # radius of the spheres in same units as the image\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. generate the spheres and show / ~ to stay with earlier convention that black is solid\n",
    "im = ~ps.generators.random_spheres(im_or_shape=shape, r=r, clearance=clearance, volume_fraction=volume_fraction, edges=edges)\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=[4, 4])\n",
    "ax.axis(False) # turn off decoration\n",
    "ax.imshow(im, origin='lower', interpolation='none', cmap='gray');\n",
    "\n",
    "# sum pixel>1/total pixels\n",
    "print(f\"Porosity: {np.sum(im > 0) / np.prod(shape):.3f}\")\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 57,
   "id": "fecefed6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Saving as vti...\n",
      "Saving as png...\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# 3. save as vti (VTK's image format)\n",
    "\n",
    "arr = np.asarray(im, dtype=int)*255  # convert to int and scale to 0-255 for VTK\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3.1 make 3D by repeating in new axis=2 dimension (openfoam and porespy want 3D)\n",
    "arr_stacked = np.stack((arr,arr), axis=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3.2 save as vti using porespy\n",
    "print('Saving as vti...')   \n",
    "ps.io.to_vtk(arr_stacked, 'porous_model_spheres')\n",
    "\n",
    "# save arr as png\n",
    "print('Saving as png...')\n",
    "im_pil = Image.fromarray(arr.astype(np.uint8))  # convert to PIL image\n",
    "im_pil.save('porous_model_spheres.png')"
   ]
  },
